StringView
⌈
A member
function shall be defined for
BasicString
that allows replacement of a subsequence
of *this with the contents of any type that is implicitly convertible to
StringView
:
template <typename T>
BasicString& replace(size_type pos1, size_type n1, const T& t,
size_type pos2, size_type n2 = npos);
This function shall behave the same as the corresponding
std::basic_string
func-
tion from [9, the C++17 standard].

BasicString
that allows replacement of an

StringView
:
BasicString& replace(const_iterator i1, const_iterator i2, StringView sv);
This function shall behave the same as the corresponding
std::basic_string
func-
tion from [9, the C++17 standard].
